row.answer: Riven is a Fighter/Assassin who chains physical-damage dashes with empowered basic attacks. Her build focus is AD, and her ultimate adds attack damage, reach and a ranged finisher that hurts more as health falls.
row.counterplay: Keep space from her dash-and-stun engage; disengage during her ultimate and avoid its ranged finisher when low.
